name: Jumbo Afterstory
source:
A game where you be friends with a goofy lil furry named Jumby!

[From [url=https://wolfcake101.itch.io/jumby-afterstory-demo]Itch.io[/url]]

A fluffy parody of Monika Afterstory.
translation:
在这款游戏里，你可以和一位名叫Jumby、傻乎乎又可爱的兽人交朋友！

[摘自[url=https://wolfcake101.itch.io/jumby-afterstory-demo]itch.io[/url]]

一部毛茸茸的《莫妮卡后日谈》戏仿作品。
